Hi Marcos — thanks for the heads up.

We can process a vendor bank rekey but AP requires:
1) Completed vendor change form (signed by an authorized officer) — use the form here: https://app.redwood.com/docs/vendor-change-form
2) A copy of a voided check or bank letter (you attached the voided check, thanks)
3) Updated W-9 (for US entities) reflecting the new EIN
4) Confirmation of the PO number that will be paid to the new account (you mentioned PO 12345).

Note on timing: once we receive the signed form + W-9, AP typically needs up to 7–10 business days to validate and apply the update before disbursing against the next payment run. If the invoice is urgent, please indicate that in the vendor change form and we can escalate.

I’m looping in Ben (procurement) and Lauren (AP) to coordinate the intake.

Best,
Maya
